notes.title: Coming Soon
notes.content:
Next Monday three DLCs are going to be released (two for XXL and one for XXZ).

For a long time we have been trying to put the ideas announced in Darkside into practice. Unfortunately, due to a number of restrictions which were introduced in the base game, we have not been able to switch Zombies with people. Hence, we decided to keep this traditional confrontation as it is.
Let us introduce a new DLC – [b]Squad[/b].

http://store.steampowered.com/app/828500/XXZ_Squad/


Now we address those who have for the moment limited themselves to purchasing a base game only and are now thinking about buying the DLC. We are going to release [b]Dead Souls Trial[/b] in which the first two missions will be available.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/785810/XXZ_Dead_Souls_Trial/

Almost 6 months have passed since free XXZ was released. During all this time game collectors kept asking us to add a commercial DLC which will help them to bind the game to their accounts. On March 26 we are going to release a small DLC with Dead Souls mechanics, new characters, and a new reward.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/828490/

notes.content:

Start the main game and press F6.

Special thanks for help in finding an error - SASDST.

notes.title: Big Update: New Campaign (+8 levels)
notes.content:
XXL users will get their presents few weeks earlier.
A new campaign has been added which contains 8 new levels and a new class of enemies.
In total, the game now has 50 levels, which correspond to approximately 3.5-5 hours of play.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30353377/e6506081f233369083a79a0be49f8bb489ffe4cc.png[/img]

Zombie girls now have a new pet – [b]headcrab[/b].
[b]First move:[/b] the headcrab jumps on you.
[b]Second move:[/b] it digs its claws into your head.
[b]Third move:[/b] being affected by the parasite, you start causing yourself damage, equal to your attack.

Just like when getting rid of the fishing net and the chain, you need to complete a row of tiles of the corresponding color (if there’s no concussion - hammer).

[b]Do we plan to introduce other updates?[/b]
It’s difficult to say. For the moment, only 2.5% of XXL users have provided game reviews.
It’s totally unclear whether other players are interested in the game. Sure, we have no resources for developing the game just for fifty users.
